targets.rawSql:
WITH last_attempt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key)
    source_key, status
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_sources,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS received_sources,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed_sources
  FROM last_attempt
),
schedule AS (
  SELECT next_run_at, cron_expression
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_schedule_status
  WHERE id = 1 AND $UserIsAdmin = 1
),
last_run AS (
  SELECT MAX(started_at) AS last_import_at
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
)
SELECT row_to_json(t)::text AS stats_json
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.total_sources,
    c.received_sources,
    c.failed_sources,
    CASE WHEN c.total_sources > 0 THEN ROUND(c.received_sources * 100.0 / c.total_sources) ELSE 0 END AS received_pct,
    CASE WHEN c.total_sources > 0 THEN ROUND(c.failed_sources * 100.0 / c.total_sources) ELSE 0 END AS failed_pct,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.next_run_at) * 1000)::bigint AS next_run_ms,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lr.last_import_at) * 1000)::bigint AS last_run_ms,
    s.cron_expression
  FROM counts c
  LEFT JOIN schedule s ON true
  LEFT JOIN last_run lr ON true
) t
WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH last_attempt AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key)
    source_key, started_at, status, error_message
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE $UserIsAdmin = 1
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
last_success AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (source_key)
    source_key, started_at
  FROM heart360tk_reporting.import_run_log
  WHERE status = 'success' AND $UserIsAdmin = 1
  ORDER BY source_key, started_at DESC
),
final_rows AS (
  SELECT
    la.source_key,
    CASE WHEN la.status = 'success' THEN 'received' ELSE 'failed' END AS status,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ls.started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS last_success_ms,
    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM la.started_at) * 1000)::bigint AS last_attempt_ms,
    CASE WHEN la.status = 'failed' THEN COALESCE(la.error_message, 'Import failed') ELSE NULL END AS failure_reason
  FROM last_attempt la
  LEFT JOIN last_success ls ON ls.source_key = la.source_key
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(final_rows) ORDER BY source_key) FROM final_rows), '[]'::json)::text AS rows_json
